name: Alfa Apartman
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Alfa Apartman. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyModern Comforts: Alfa Apartman in Baku offers a recently renovated apartment with free WiFi, air-conditioning, and a fully equipped kitchenette. Guests enjoy garden views, a living room with a sofa bed, and a dining area.

Convenient Facilities: The property provides private check-in and check-out, a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and a tour desk. Additional amenities include a paid shuttle service, electric vehicle charging station, and bicycle parking.

Prime Location: Located 24 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport, the apartment is a short walk from Freedom Square and Maiden Tower. Nearby attractions include the Palace of The Shirvanshahs and Fountains Square. An ice-skating rink is also in the surroundings.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
fine_print: This property will not accommodate hen, stag or similar parties.

hostInfo.name: DelqiStay LLC
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
This property is designed as a one-bedroom studio apartment concept to offer comfortable and practical accommodation. The apartment features a separate bedroom with a single bed. The living area and kitchen are located within the same space and are arranged to comfortably meet guests' daily needs.
The apartment has a private bathroom and toilet. Air conditioning is also available to ensure a comfortable stay throughout the year. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property.
The property is located on the ground floor (1st floor) and is very easy to access. Its location offers a significant advantage, especially for city stays. Located on Nizami Street, one of the most central points in Baku, the property is an ideal choice for guests who want to be close to shopping, dining and city life.
There are 24-hour markets, restaurants, cafes and various service points around the property. All these facilities are within easy walking distance.
An airport transfer service is available for guests upon request. With its central location, facilities and easy access, this property is an ideal accommodation option for both business and leisure travellers.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Delqistay LLC,
has been operating in the accommodation sector since 2020.
The company has 20 city centre flats and 5 hotels.
All our facilities are located in the city centre, in easily accessible locations.
With a service approach focused on cleanliness, comfort and guest satisfaction,
for short and long-term stays.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
The street where the property is located is situated in one of the city's most prestigious and vibrant areas. The street has direct access to Xaqani Park. The park, which stands out for its modern design and abundance of trees, offers an ideal environment for guests who wish to walk, relax and escape the stress of the city.
Nizami Avenue is located just off the street, and this area is one of the city's most important commercial and residential centres. Along Nizami Avenue, there are numerous shopping centres, shops, restaurants, cafés and entertainment venues.
The area also has children's clubs, indoor and outdoor parking areas, museums, theatres and various cultural venues. Every kind of service and social space that might be needed for city life can be found on this street and its surroundings.
Thanks to its central location, public transport and city transport are very easy. With its safe, lively and vibrant atmosphere during the day and night, this street offers great advantages for both tourist and business stays.
